text:
Suspected bandits have killed a 37-year-old Chinese national, Wang Tingjian, who worked with Zurfi Mining Company, and his police escort, Inspector Abba Ya’u, attached to MOPOL 34, Gombe State, in an ambush in Bauchi State.
The incident occurred on Saturday at about 1:30 p.m. in Ruga Village, Gwana District, Alkaleri Local Government Area of the state.
Confirming the incident to Channels Television in a telephone interview on Monday, the Police Public Relations Officer (PPRO), SP Nafiu Habib, said the Chinese miner was conducting a survey at a mining site when he and his escort were attacked by suspected gunmen.
He explained that the attack triggered an exchange of gunfire between the security operatives and the assailants.
“During the survey, they were ambushed by unknown gunmen. The Chinese national had even run towards the vehicle conveying them for safety, but they were overwhelmed,” Habib said.
According to the PPRO, the victims were rushed to the Federal Teaching Hospital, Gombe, where they were confirmed dead and their bodies deposited in the hospital’s mortuary.
Habib further disclosed that the anti-kidnapping unit and the Violent Crime Response Unit, in collaboration with the military and local vigilantes, were conducting a manhunt for the attackers.
He added that security agencies were also working to unravel the circumstances surrounding the incident.
